spells.targets: Select one individually perceptible ongoing magical shield effect and designate one creature it currently protects. Both its legal effect-targeting locus and that creature must be perceived, within 30 feet and line of effect from you, at commitment and resolution. spells.duration: Instantaneous ending and subsequent damage, no concentration.
spells.resolution: After paid commitment, resolve actual hidden eligibility: spell origin, recorded generating rank 0–1, eligible protective identity, ongoing operational defense of the designated creature, and susceptibility to ending. Failure of any required predicate means no ending, no damage, no replacement target and no refund. If eligible, automatically end exactly that selected effect/component through its ordinary parent/dependency callbacks. Only after successful ending, deal one automatic1d8 force packet to the designated still-legal creature. No attack/save is added. If the effect cannot actually end, there is no damage fallback.
spells.effect: NEW eligible-shield definition: one individually perceptible ongoing magical effect generated by an actual rank-0 or rank-1 spell whose source expressly identifies or describes it as a shield, barrier, ward or unambiguous equivalent magical protective layer, and which currently retains at least one operational defensive component protecting the designated creature. Defensive components include attack/AC protection, damage prevention/reduction/absorption, projectile or creature interception, saving-throw protection, or an actual magical defensive boundary. A generic defensive benefit does not qualify without that source-qualified identity. Stronger same-stat numerical supersession does not end eligibility; actual complete suppression of every defensive component prevents eligibility until protection resumes. An active conditional defense need not currently be triggered. The actual generating rank controls, not RP spent, discount, dispeller level or a different class placement. Reviewed examples: Arcane Ward, active Shield, active Barrier Flicker, Corruption Ward and unconsumed Minor Elemental Ward qualify subject to all gates. Rank-1 Abjuration Alignment Shield qualifies without a currently attacking opposed-alignment creature; its rank-3 Conjuration application fails the rank ceiling. Resonance Shield qualifies only if its own accepted current temporary-HP grant has points remaining and has not expired/depleted/replaced. The reviewed finite source-owned grant is an ongoing effect despite old Instantaneous metadata; this does not make historical instantaneous consequences generically dispellable. Remove only that actual accepted grant administratively, never a discarded historical grant or a replacement False Life/class pool. Administrative removal is not damage, a hit or paid absorption and triggers depletion/removal hooks only where their actual wording covers it. For Protective Sphere, choose one perceived actual boundary point within 30 feet/line of effect as the effect locus, and one perceived creature actually inside it also within 30 feet/line of effect. That creature need not be the owner, and no projectile must be in flight. End the whole one selected maintained sphere application and its actual dependencies, not a hole or segment; overlapping independent spheres remain. An outside creature cannot be designated merely through hypothetical protection by the sphere.
